Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

package Problems_On_String;

public class LargestWord {
    static String maxLength(String str) {
        int len = str.length();
        int i = 0, j = 0;
        String maxWord = "";
        int max_length = 0, max_start = 0;

        while (j <= len) {
            if (j < len && str.charAt(j) != ' ')
                j++;

            else {
                int curr_length = j - i;

                if (curr_length > max_length) {
                    max_length = curr_length;
                    max_start = i;
                }
                j++;
                i = j;
            }
        }

        maxWord = str.substring(max_start, max_length);
        return maxWord;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String str = "Google Docs";

        System.out.print("Largest Word is: " + maxLength(str));

    }
}
